title: gate-live gate-stopped event
description: A gate ended on request (`gate-live.mjs stop --now`): its tap ended the gate's process group and gate-runner recorded nothing for it. Never a verdict: no closure evidence, no gate-verdict, no reading and no red stands for the stopped gate, and a run that carries one closes `interrupted` with the three-part answer in its v1 run-close. It lives here, beside its only consumer (gate-live-schema.test.mjs), and not in elohim/sdk/schemas/v1/gate-live-event.schema.json, for the notice addendum's reason: that directory is a storage build source, and editing it would roll Edge for a device-local vocabulary. Its end: it is merged with the v1 file into one orchestrator-local schema at the next deliberate Edge roll, with the notice addendum. Until then the three files partition the kinds, held by gate-live-schema.test.mjs.

step.description: The gate's step that was running when it was stopped, when it was not the recipe itself (rust-style).

by.description: The stopping caller's session (`epr session id`), or null when it had none.

signal.description: The last signal sent to the gate's process group: SIGTERM when every member ended within the grace, SIGKILL when the grace ran out, null when nothing of the gate was left to signal.

survivors.description: Pids of the gate still alive after the KILL wait, when any.

escaped.description: Present when the tap stopped waiting on the gate's output pipes after its tree was ended: the processes outside the tree still holding them (they may still run; never signalled, since they are no longer provably the gate's). Empty when none was found.

evidence.description: No verdict is recorded for the gate. What it already wrote (step scratch, build products) or put (a producer offer) is not undone.
